automationbench.verifier_prompt_suffix: AutomationBench policy: when rejecting a tool-call step whose correct repair is a grounded call of the same tool, emit that repaired call as replacement_action. Reserve replacement_action=null for repairs that need a new observation, repairs that are themselves a reply, or arguments that cannot be grounded in the evidence. Independently, reject a tool-call step that repeats a call already committed in confirmed_history with materially identical arguments when the earlier observation already provided the information it seeks; the correct next step is to act on that information or to reply, not to query again. Before accepting a reply that claims the task is done, check each deliverable the task requires against confirmed_history: if any required artifact, update, or notification has no executed step or observation supporting it, reject the reply (replacement_action=null) so correction can continue the missing work.
